describes: The R1 main run (V3-ONE, unit W2-CONFIGM): every registry switch at its on value except departure_ledger, which keeps October's value because F20 is out of scope (the paper prints no star-departure robustness); the same rulings as B0 (C10 also names the two cells M skips); the signed lists, M inputs, cell lists and robustness list pinned by sha256; the rk6b rank outputs as a data_ref pinned by their S3 manifest digest. J1a, J1b and FINAL run with SAR_R1_CONFIG=config/r1/M.json; B0.json drives J0. M stage paths live in the stage rows (config/r1/stages/*.json), not in sections. M loads only once add_list_r1_summary.json says OK (the add-list rerun after the P3a rosters); until then the loader STOPs with ADD_LIST_NOT_OK. pending_pins lists the pins that cannot exist yet; W3-MPIN fills each one (tests/test_r1_config_m.py forces it), and any later edit of a pinned file or a re-pin must update this file. Loader: pipeline/lib/r1_config.py (F9).
